book_title: Chapter 7: Pricing the Impossible—Reverse DCF, Discrete 2x Decay, and Peer Comps
question: What cash-flow expectations are priced into Nebius Group, and what does the discrete 2x GBM formula imply for NBIL at $2.29?

epigraph.quote: A leveraged daily ETF does not merely double the destination's variance; it deducts the square of volatility from every step along the path.
epigraph.author: Quantitative Portfolio Construction Desk

web_blocks.html: Pricing NBIL at its November 20, 2026 close of $2.29 requires a two-layer valuation bridge [57]. First, we reverse-engineer what cash flow Nebius Group (NBIS) must earn to justify its capital base [48]. Second, we pass NBIS's 12-month equity returns through NBIL's discrete 2x Geometric Brownian Motion (GBM) formula [5][42][43]. NBIL fell -32.45% on November 20 alone and -96.66% from its $68.49 52-week high [57]. That collapse reflects NBIS's massive funding overhang colliding with NBIL's compounding wrapper drag [42][43][48].

web_blocks.title: Layer 1: Reverse DCF and Capital-Stack Reality of Nebius Group (NBIS)

web_blocks.html: The market is repricing NBIS from a high-multiple AI cloud story into a leveraged infrastructure utility [17][48]. Because NBIS is absent from the November 20 ledgers, we use its 7-day-old November 13, 2026 baseline ($115.88 close; ~$31.49B market cap) to frame Q3 2026 senior claims [40][48]. NBIS carries $14.19 billion of carrying debt ($16.48 billion principal) plus October's $3.50 billion Citigroup 364-day secured facility [48][49]. Notes 8 and 11 add $16.59 billion of off-balance-sheet obligations: $13.86 billion in uncommenced leases and $2.73 billion in power contracts [48]. Alongside $1.46 billion in VIE exposure and $7.43 billion of unrestricted cash, senior claims sit far ahead of equity [48].

On the income statement, Q3 2026 revenue of $980.8 million included $325.1 million in lumpy strategic-partnership revenue [47][48]. GAAP operating profit of +$50.4 million also leaned on extending server useful lives from four to five years on January 1, 2026 [48]. That accounting change cut depreciation by $43.1 million in Q3 and $129.2 million across 9M 2026 [48]. Meanwhile, 9M 2026 CapEx reached $15.43 billion. Management guides ~$27 billion for FY2026 and $40–$45 billion for FY2027 against $12–$13 billion of FY2027 sales [46][48]. To justify a 10% equity hurdle across 292.90 million shares (313.97 million with NVIDIA warrants), NBIS must reach >35% operating margins while slashing CapEx by 70%+ [45][48].

web_blocks.takeaway: Once $16.48B of principal debt, the $3.5B Citi facility, and $16.59B of uncommenced leases and power commitments are stacked ahead of 313.97M diluted shares, NBIS common equity functions as a high-beta residual claim on flawless multi-year execution.

web_blocks.title: Layer 2: Discrete 2x GBM Wrapper Math & NBIL Fair-Value Simulation

web_blocks.html: Even if an investor predicts NBIS's destination, NBIL's daily-reset wrapper distorts the payoff [5]. Under discrete GBM with daily leverage L = 2, annual variance drag equals 0.5 × L × (L - 1) × σ² = 1.0 × σ². Adding annual wrapper and swap financing cost cnet yields RNBIL = exp(2 × ln(1 + RNBIS) − σ² − cnet) − 1 [5][42][43]. Our model uses cnet = 9.50% as a conservative lower bound (1.41% net ER, 1.45% indirect swap cost, and ~6.64% midpoint net spread). Because NBIL pays OBFR01 + 600 bps on 2x swap notional while earning T-bill yield on only ~1x cash collateral, true annual drag at ~4.0% OBFR01 can approach ~19.36% (making our -$1.27 base drop conservative) [42][43].

web_blocks.the_number: $1.02 Base Case 12-month NBIL target (-55.40% from $2.29 CMP) and $1.23 expected value (-46.44%).
web_blocks.how_calculated: We apply the discrete 2x GBM formula R_NBIL = exp(2 * ln(1 + R_NBIS) - sigma^2 - c_net) - 1 across three 12-month NBIS regimes from $2.29 and weight by scenario odds.
web_blocks.the_inputs: CMP equals $2.29 with c_net at a conservative 9.50% lower bound (2.86% prospectus fees plus ~6.64% net spread; 2x notional vs. 1x collateral can lift true drag toward ~19.36%). Base assumes R_NBIS +5% at 90% volatility, Bear -45% at 105%, and Bull +65% at 70%.
web_blocks.the_range: Bear is $0.21 (-90.87%, 35% weight), Base is $1.02 (-55.40%, 45% weight), and Bull is $3.47 (+51.67%, 20% weight). Probability weighting gives $1.23 per share.
web_blocks.if_off: If NBIS rallies over 57.2% in 12 months while volatility drops below 90%, NBIL can exceed $2.29. Conversely, full 2x notional swap financing (~19.36% drag) or sub-$1.00 trading risks even steeper decay, reverse splits, or trust closure.

web_blocks.takeaway: At 90% annualized volatility and 9.50% audited fee and swap-financing drag, NBIL loses 55.4% even if NBIS rises 5% over 12 months, requiring a +57.2% NBIS rally just to break even at $2.29.

web_blocks.title: Peer Snapshot Matrix: Neocloud & AI Infrastructure De-Rating

web_blocks.html: The November 20, 2026 cross-section confirms that NBIL's collapse mirrors a sector-wide breakdown across debt-heavy AI compute providers. Direct neocloud peer CoreWeave (CRWV) trades at $39.51 (-71.42% from its 52-week high) with -63.95% ROE and 16.45x debt-to-equity, while DigitalOcean (DOCN), IREN, Oracle (ORCL), and Vertiv (VRT) all sit in Stage 4 Markdown. Meanwhile, within the 2x NBIS ETF niche, rivals NEBX (1.30% ER, $353.37M AUM) and NBIG (0.76% ER, $90.37M AUM) undercut NBIL's 1.41% net ER and diversify across four swap dealers [54][55][56]. NBIL's shrinking $62.26 million asset pool leaves it exposed to closure risk after GraniteShares liquidated 12 sub-scale YieldBOOST ETFs on November 19, 2026 [44][59].

web_blocks.takeaway: Every pure-play AI infrastructure and neocloud comparator in the November 20 snapshot (CRWV, DOCN, IREN, ORCL, VRT) has fallen into Stage 4 Markdown alongside NBIL, leaving hyperscaler Microsoft (Stage 3) as the sole non-Stage-4 peer.

web_blocks.html: Valuation reality offers zero margin of safety for new capital in NBIL. Even if NBIS rallies sharply over 12 months, NBIL's single-dealer Clear Street swap toll, 2.86% prospectus fee-and-indirect-swap drag, and 1.0x variance penalty erode upside while amplifying downside gaps [5][42][43]. Investors who want exposure to AI compute growth should analyze unlevered Stage 2 compounders or wait for unlevered NBIS to build a Stage 1 base after 2027 financing clears.

Valuation Re-Evaluation Trigger: Re-underwrite only if unlevered NBIS achieves positive free cash flow visibility without dilutive equity or secured bridge debt, AND NBIL's realized 60-day volatility compresses sustainably below 60% while AUM stabilizes above $150M.

book_paragraphs: To price a leveraged daily exchange-traded fund accurately, an analyst must look through the wrapper's ticker symbol and value two separate engines. The first engine is the underlying enterprise, Nebius Group, whose equity claim sits behind billions of dollars in senior debt, convertible notes, data-center lease commitments, and fixed power contracts. The second engine is the GraniteShares wrapper itself, which converts every oscillation in the parent stock into a mathematical toll through daily rebalancing and floating swap spreads.

When we open Nebius Group's third-quarter 2026 footnotes, the valuation puzzle snaps into focus. At first glance, ninety-eighty million dollars of quarterly revenue and a slim positive operating profit suggest an inflection point. Underneath the headline, however, three-hundred-twenty-five million dollars came from non-recurring strategic partnerships, and a change in server depreciation from four years to five years boosted operating profit by forty-three million dollars in the quarter alone.

Far more consequential is the senior claim stack revealed in Notes 8 and 11. Nebius carries sixteen point four-eight billion dollars of principal debt, bolstered its liquidity in October 2026 with a three-point-five-billion-dollar secured Citigroup facility, and holds thirteen-point-eight-six billion dollars in uncommenced lease obligations plus two-point-seven-three billion dollars in fixed power purchase commitments. Against seven-point-four-three billion dollars of unrestricted cash, common equity sits at the very bottom of a thirty-six-billion-dollar funding tower while management guides up to forty-five billion dollars of capital spending in 2027.

That funding reality guarantees violent swings in Nebius's stock price, which brings the second valuation engine into play. Under discrete Geometric Brownian Motion, a two-times daily reset ETF suffers variance drag equal to one-point-zero times the square of annualized volatility. At ninety percent volatility, variance drag alone consumes more than half of a flat year, and Clear Street's audited swap rate of OBFR01 plus six hundred basis points adds roughly nine and a half percent in total annual wrapper and financing drag.

Plugging those verified inputs into the discrete compounding equation from the November 20 close of two dollars and twenty-nine cents produces stark numbers. Even if Nebius shares edge up five percent over the next twelve months at ninety percent volatility, NBIL drops fifty-five percent to one dollar and two cents. Only a rapid sixty-five percent rally paired with falling volatility lifts the bull case to three dollars and forty-seven cents, while a funding crunch drives the bear case down to twenty-one cents and risks reverse splits or fund liquidation.

Translating these two discrete layers into disciplined portfolio decisions requires readers to see why traditional valuation multiples fail on leveraged single-stock wrappers. Unlevered Nebius Group sits in a capital-intensive hyperscale buildout phase where reported GAAP operating income relies heavily on useful-life depreciation assumptions while multi-year purchase, lease, and power commitments expand rapidly off the balance sheet. Meanwhile, asset-light strategic partnership revenues introduced episodic quarterly surges that cannot simply be capitalized at steady-state software multiples without risking severe valuation compression.

Even if unlevered Nebius common equity eventually stabilizes and finds institutional sponsorship after its massive capital expenditure cycle matures, NBIL holders do not own a permanent ticket on that long-term infrastructure runway. Every week spent chopping sideways or grinding downward erodes the daily-reset net asset value through discrete variance drag proportional to index variance, pushing the required recovery hurdle higher and turning passive holding into guaranteed real capital attrition.

book_subsections.title: Why Peer Comps Confirm a Sector-Wide De-Rating
paragraphs: The November 20, 2026 market snapshot confirms that Nebius is not suffering in isolation. Every leveraged AI compute builder in our peer matrix—CoreWeave at thirty-nine dollars and fifty-one cents, DigitalOcean at sixty-six dollars and seventy-six cents, IREN at eleven dollars and eighty-two cents, Oracle at one hundred one dollars and nineteen cents, and Vertiv at one hundred sixty-six dollars and twenty-four cents—sits in Stage 4 Markdown. Credit markets are demanding proof that multi-billion-dollar GPU clusters convert into unlevered free cash flow before server hardware depreciates.

Inside the single-stock ETF niche itself, NBIL also loses on unit economics. Competing two-times NBIS funds such as Tradr's NEBX and Leverage Shares' NBIG charge lower expense ratios of one-point-three-zero percent and zero-point-seven-six percent while spreading counterparty risk across four swap dealers. With NBIL's assets shrinking sixty-eight percent since June to sixty-two point two-six million dollars—just one day after GraniteShares announced the liquidation of twelve sub-scale YieldBOOST ETFs—fee pressure and closure risk compound the fundamental valuation fail.

book_subsections.title: The Breakeven Hurdle Hidden from Retail Buyers
paragraphs: Most retail buyers assume that if Nebius rises twenty-five percent over a year, a two-times ETF will return fifty percent. The audited discrete formula proves otherwise. At ninety percent underlying volatility and nine-point-five percent annual wrapper and financing drag, a twenty-five percent rally in Nebius leaves NBIL down roughly thirty-seven percent at one dollar and forty-five cents.

Just to break even at two dollars and twenty-nine cents over twelve months under those volatility and financing conditions, Nebius equity must surge more than fifty-seven percent. When an asset requires heroic underlying appreciation merely to stand still, expected value turns decisively negative—here, one dollar and twenty-three cents, or forty-six percent below the current market price.

book_callouts.title: The Two-Layer Hurdle: Capital Stack Overhang Meets Variance Squared
book_callouts.text: In a normal equity, high volatility hurts your stomach but does not reduce expected terminal value if you hold through the cycle. In a 2x daily ETF, annualized volatility squared (sigma^2) is permanently deducted from your log return every year alongside OBFR+600 bps swap financing and 2.86% prospectus fees.
